form.description: Enabled is not the same as working. Confidence = data flowing + CIM normalized + BAS validated + executing without skips. The CIRT rows show the detections CIRT has approved and is monitoring, pulled from GitHub.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | eval uhgid=lower(uhgid) | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen | `dc_splunk2_scope` | eval flowing=if(isnotnull(last_seen) AND now()-last_seen<86400,1,0) | stats count as datasets_cataloged, sum(splunk2_in_scope) as datasets_in_scope, sum(eval(if(splunk2_in_scope=1 AND flowing=1,1,0))) as in_scope_flowing_24h by uhgid | append [| inputlookup dc_splunk2_allow | eval uhgid=lower(id) | stats values(sourcetype) as allowed_sourcetypes, first(name) as tenant, first(line_of_business) as line_of_business by uhgid | eval on_allow_list=1] | stats max(on_allow_list) as on_allow_list, first(tenant) as tenant, first(line_of_business) as line_of_business, values(allowed_sourcetypes) as allowed_sourcetypes, max(datasets_cataloged) as datasets_cataloged, max(datasets_in_scope) as datasets_in_scope, max(in_scope_flowing_24h) as in_scope_flowing_24h by uhgid | where on_allow_list=1 | fillnull value=0 datasets_cataloged datasets_in_scope in_scope_flowing_24h | eval allowed_sourcetypes=mvjoin(allowed_sourcetypes,", ") | table tenant uhgid line_of_business allowed_sourcetypes datasets_cataloged datasets_in_scope in_scope_flowing_24h | sort tenant

panel.title: Why mapped detections are not healthy

search.query: | inputlookup dc_attack_mapping_lookup | fillnull value="no" cirt_approved | search cirt_approved="$cirt_filter$" | where NOT (health_state IN ("trusted","acceptable") AND data_at_risk="no") | eval reason=if(data_at_risk="yes",mvappend("data at risk", split(health_reason,"; ")),split(health_reason,"; ")) | eval reason=mvfilter(reason!="all checks passed") | stats dc(ko_id) as detections by reason | sort - detections

panel.title: Silent Tier 0/1 detections - fired nothing in 90 days

search.query: | inputlookup dc_ko_lookup where enabled="yes" | where ko_tier="Tier 0" OR ko_tier="Tier 1" | lookup dc_detection_health_lookup ko_id OUTPUT last_fired runs_30d skip_rate_pct health_state | where runs_30d>20 AND (isnull(last_fired) OR last_fired<relative_time(now(),"-90d")) | eval days_silent=if(isnull(last_fired),999,round((now()-last_fired)/86400,0)) | table ko_id ko_name ko_tier owner app days_silent runs_30d skip_rate_pct health_state | sort ko_tier - days_silent

panel.title: Skipped executions - leading indicator of missed detections

search.query: | inputlookup dc_detection_health_lookup | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_name ko_tier owner enabled | where enabled="yes" AND skip_rate_pct>0 | table ko_id ko_name ko_tier owner runs_30d skipped_30d skip_rate_pct | sort - skip_rate_pct

panel.title: How coverage_state is decided, and how a technique gets to covered

div.p: 1. Map detections to the technique. DC-63 reads the ATT&CK IDs in each enabled correlation search's annotations. Every detection that names the technique (or one of its sub-techniques) counts toward it.
2. Decide whether each detection is healthy. A detection is healthy only when both are true:

ul.li: Its data is not at risk. Every dataset the detection reads (from the dependency graph, DC-12/13) was seen in the last 24 hours and has CIM capture of at least 95%.

DC-43 rates it trusted or acceptable. DC-43 checks data flowing, CIM capture of 95% or more, successful runs in 30 days with a skip rate under 5%, and a BAS test in the last 180 days (only where BAS is recorded). Trusted passes every check; acceptable misses one.

div.p: 3. Roll up to the technique (DC-62, daily at 06:00):

tr.td: Exactly one healthy detection, and at least one other has data at risk.
Two or more healthy detections, but some have data at risk.
At least one healthy detection and none with data at risk.

div.p: Getting from NO HEALTHY COVERAGE to covered: make any one mapped detection healthy. The blockers column below names each unhealthy detection and the check it failed. Fix that check, and the technique changes state on the next daily run (DC-43 at 05:05, DC-63 at 05:55, DC-62 at 06:00).

Read this first: a technique can be NO HEALTHY COVERAGE with zero detections at risk. That means the data is fine but the detections failed other checks. Those are counted in failing_checks. The most common cause is "no data source linked": the dependency graph could not tell which dataset the detection reads (for example, it uses a macro or data model), so the data and CIM checks cannot pass. The fix is in the dependency graph, not the feed.

panel.title: ATT&CK techniques by coverage state - what is blocking each one

search.query: | search coverage_state="$state_filter$" | where "$cirt_filter$"="*" OR detections_cirt_approved>0 | sort state_order - detections_at_risk technique | rename detections_total as total, detections_healthy as healthy, detections_at_risk as data_at_risk, detections_failing_checks as failing_checks, detections_cirt_approved as cirt_approved, detections_cirt_healthy as cirt_healthy | table technique technique_name tactic coverage_state total healthy data_at_risk failing_checks cirt_approved cirt_healthy blockers next_step datasets_supporting

panel.title: ATT&CK technique detail - live detection mapping for a technique

search.query: | inputlookup dc_attack_mapping_lookup | stats count by technique, technique_name | eval label=if(technique_name!="",technique." - ".technique_name,technique) | sort technique

| inputlookup dc_attack_mapping_lookup | fillnull value="no" cirt_approved | search technique="$mitre_technique$" cirt_approved="$cirt_filter$" | eval technique_display=if(technique_name!="",technique." - ".technique_name,technique), healthy=if(data_at_risk="no" AND health_state IN ("trusted","acceptable"),"yes","no") | table technique_display tactic sub_technique ko_name cirt_approved cirt_environment healthy health_state health_reason data_at_risk datasets_supporting ko_tier app owner source | sort technique_display - cirt_approved healthy ko_tier

html.p: For the full ATT&CK technique-by-tactic coverage matrix (production and risk-accepted detections vs. the complete ctm_mitre_lookup technique set), see the MITRE ATT&CK Coverage Matrix dashboard. CIRT's approved list and the Splunk 2.0 allow list refresh from GitHub every 30 minutes once the cirt_* pulls are enabled (Apps > Data inputs > GitHub File Pull).
